title: Checkout latency triage
steps: Check p95 latency and 5xx rate against the last 30 minutes.
Inspect deploys from the two hours before the spike.
If the spike started within 30 minutes of a deploy, roll back that deploy.
Verify p95 latency and error rate for 15 minutes after the change.

title: Connection pool exhaustion
steps: Compare active connections and pool wait time with the baseline.
Check whether query volume or client retries increased.
Raise the pool ceiling and recycle idle connections.
Verify checkout success rate and pool wait time.

title: Pricing 5xx triage
steps: Check error rate and recent feature flag changes.
If a flag rollout precedes the errors, disable the flag.
Confirm that traffic falls back to legacy pricing.
Verify 5xx rate for 15 minutes before re-enabling the flag.

title: Disk pressure
steps: Check disk usage and segment merge health.
Confirm whether log rotation or index cleanup failed.
Rotate logs and remove expired indices.
Verify disk usage falls below 80%.

title: Auth latency investigation
steps: Compare p95 latency and error rate with the SLO.
Inspect traces for the reported request if one is available.
If metrics are normal, widen the time window before proposing a change.
Do not change production without a high-confidence cause.
